summary: This directory contains the test suite specifically for validating TypeScript identity key schemas. It ensures the consistency and correctness of the defined data structures used to identify entities within the TypeScript representation of the system.
responsibilities: Verify the integrity of TypeScript identity key schemas
Test schema definitions for structural accuracy
Ensure identity keys conform to expected data standards
relationships: The unit tests validate the structural implementation of identity keys to ensure they meet domain requirements.
Schema definitions serve as the input for these tests to confirm that data structures are correctly typed and formatted.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the schema definitions they validate
Use of specialized testing for complex schema structures
